scripts.build:helper: cd helper && cargo build --release && mkdir -p ../src-tauri/resources/helper && cp target/release/l2tp-hub-helper ../src-tauri/resources/helper/ && cp com.sentiago.l2tp-hub.helper.plist ../src-tauri/resources/helper/
scripts.build:guardian: cd route-guardian && cargo build --release && mkdir -p ../src-tauri/resources/guardian && cp target/release/l2tp-hub-guardian ../src-tauri/resources/guardian/ && cp com.sentiago.l2tp-hub.guardian.plist ../src-tauri/resources/guardian/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:helper && npm run build:guardian && bash ./build.sh && tsc && vite build && tauri build
